rationale: Price sits above the 9-EMA of $156.02 after the latest four 1-minute candles carved higher lows near 155.95 and produced a high-volume thrust to 156.57; it has also reclaimed 35% of the day’s range from the 151.50 low while the broad market is up 0.52% and VIXY is down 3.35%.
